name: codealpha-project-management
description: TaskFlow - A collaborative project management tool (CodeAlpha Full Stack Development, Task 3). MERN stack with JWT auth, Kanban boards, task comments, and real-time WebSocket updates.

scripts.install-all: concurrently "cd client; npm install" "cd server; npm install"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "cd server; npm run dev" "cd client; npm run dev"
scripts.lint: cd server; npm run lint; cd ../client; npm run lint
scripts.test: cd server; npm test; cd ../client; npm test
